section_summary.extract_value: This introduction section discusses the construct of positive body image and body appreciation, focusing on the development and validation of the Body Appreciation Scale (BAS) and its revised version, the Body Appreciation Scale-2 (BAS-2). It reviews various studies that have examined the factor structure of both scales across different countries and populations, noting both one-dimensional and two-dimensional structures for BAS and a consistent one-dimensional structure for BAS-2. The section also touches upon sex differences in BAS-2 scores reported in previous research.
